newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma ranges after central bank intervention.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma ranges after central bank intervention.

text.p: The drachma reversed course and strengthened against the ecu and the mark after the central bank sold large amounts of ecus and marks for drachmas at the fixing, depos, forex forwards and bonds were steady, traders said.

"Ecu/drachma is trading around 311.65/75 in late trade," said a forex dealer a at foreign bank. "Ecu/drachma fell sharply to 311.40 after the central bank intervened but firmed shortly after on ecu buying from London-based players."
The central bank sold about $150 million, 50 million ecus and 30 million marks for drachmas at today's fixing.

"The message to the market from today's intervention is loud and clear," said Panos Panayiotopoulos, assistant treasurer at private Alpha Credit Bank. "The hard drachma policy is still in place because this is the main anti-inflationary tool."
Interbank depos, forex forwards and bonds were little changed in late dealings, dealers said.
The mark was quoted at 159.80/90 from Thursday's 159.740 fix, the dollar at 270.02/12 drachmas from 270.060 and the ecu at 311.68/78 from 311.400 drachmas.
